title: DOUBLE CHECK THE KNIFE
question: Do the strongest SQ-03D paired-background context-residual effects survive independent scalar re-execution of both subject counterfactuals, while frozen near-zero controls remain near-zero?

panel_selection.source: SQ-03D authoritative result plus deterministic replay of the frozen SQ-03D analyzer against the exact hashed SQ-03B ledger solely to recover complete row identities needed for low-tail selection

upper: rank all eligible pairs by frozen upper-tail ranking
seed the panel with the first 2 pairs for each input
fill remaining slots from the global ranking, skipping already selected pairs
low: rank all eligible pairs by frozen low-tail ranking
seed the control panel with the first 2 remaining pairs for each input
fill remaining slots from the global low-tail ranking, skipping already selected pairs

acceptance.upper_tail: all selected upper-tail pairs must reproduce both subject counterfactuals within the already-frozen SQ-03B/SQ-03C numerical agreement contract
acceptance.low_tail: all low-tail controls must reproduce within the same numerical agreement contract

claim_boundary: SQ-03D.1 can verify that selected SQ-03D context-dependent hotspots survive an independent scalar execution path. It does not establish a biological sex mechanism, population-level statistical significance, organism-level behavior, intelligence differences, or financial utility.

protocol_amendments.reason: The authoritative SQ-03D result stores the complete summaries and top 100 ranked pairs but not every low-tail row identity. Before panel selection, the protocol was amended to permit deterministic replay of the already-frozen SQ-03D analysis over the exact same hashed SQ-03B ledger solely to recover those identities.
protocol_amendments.scientific_effect: No selection thresholds, ranking rules, panel sizes, runtime mechanics, or acceptance criteria changed.

protocol_amendments.reason: Before panel selection, the stratification language was made fully algorithmic so the 16-pair upper and low panels can be derived without operator discretion.
protocol_amendments.scientific_effect: No panel size, ranking key, minimum-per-input requirement, runtime mechanic, numerical tolerance, or acceptance criterion changed.
